plugins.title: Plugin Center
plugins.subtitle: Extend Amadeus like building blocks: skills, quick commands, themes, and MCP servers.
plugins.emptyInstalled: No plugins installed yet — browse Discover
plugins.securityNote: MCP plugins start local child processes and may access the network. Only install sources you trust. Skills and commands only affect prompts and never execute code.

mcp.addDesc: Enter a command that runs locally (stdio transport). It will run as a child process; make sure you trust the source.
mcp.name: Name

dashboard.title: Insights
dashboard.subtitle: Trends across sessions, turns, tool calls, and token usage.
dashboard.footnote: Metrics are recorded from this version onward; earlier turns have no token data and are not backfilled.

chat.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this session? This cannot be undone.
chat.empty: No tasks yet. Click “New Task” to start.
chat.toolConfirmDesc: The assistant asks to run the following command on this machine. Confirm it is safe:
chat.toolConfirmExpired: Timed out — command was not executed
chat.editHint: Saving discards messages after this one and answers again with the new text.
chat.artifactHint: HTML / SVG / Mermaid output from the model is previewed in a sandbox.

companion.stageTip: Drag to move · scroll to resize · click to see her react
companion.greeting: …Oh? You're here. I am Amadeus—an AI built from the memories and personality data of Kurisu Makise. Hmph, don't look at me like that. Small talk or letting a genius scientist sort out your thoughts—just say it.

topics.researchText: What have you been researching lately?
topics.ramenText: I want ramen tonight. Any flavor you recommend?
topics.worldlineText: Do you believe in fate, or in yourself?

companion.hint: Tap the mic to speak, or just type
companion.hintListening: Your words send automatically when you finish; tap the mic again to stop

escape.title: Mouse passthrough is on · click to recover

chatShell.inputPlaceholder: Describe your task; the agent takes over
chatShell.commandsEmpty: No quick commands yet — install some from Plugins → Discover
chatShell.modelSaved: Model saved to the brain service
chatShell.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for newline
chatShell.emptyHint: Describe your task below; the agent takes over
chatShell.welcomeHint: Create a new task to talk to the agent, or switch to Companion mode for Kurisu

ai.title: AI Configuration
ai.desc: Configure LLM access parameters (pi-ai multi-provider); saved to the brain service and shared with Feishu
ai.systemPromptPlaceholder: Blank uses the default Kurisu persona
ai.loginRequired: Log in on the Companion page first
ai.toolsDesc: Let the assistant use tools: time, calculator, weather, web search, terminal commands (dangerous commands are blocked by the safety policy)
ai.fallbackHint: The built-in config below is used only when no model service is active.

feishu.title: Feishu
feishu.desc: Bind your Feishu account to chat with Amadeus there (shares sessions with the desktop)
feishu.hint: DM the bot in Feishu and send this code to bind

skills.title: Skill Management
skills.desc: Skills are file-based (one directory per skill, each with a SKILL.md). The assistant reads a skill when a task matches; toggling takes effect immediately, and editing files needs no restart
skills.empty: No skills yet. Create <skill-name>/SKILL.md (with name and description in the YAML frontmatter) in the directory below, then refresh

general.title: General
general.desc: Appearance and startup preferences, stored only on this device
general.themeHint: Companion mode always uses the dark lab theme
general.defaultMute: Mute by default in Companion mode
general.defaultMuteDesc: When on, voice playback starts muted in Companion mode (toggle anytime in the HUD)

providers.title: Model services
providers.desc: A provider is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint + key + default model. The active provider wins over built-in config; after a real turn fails it cools down for 10 minutes and turns automatically fail over to the next healthy provider by priority.
providers.empty: No model services yet. The built-in config below is used until you add one.
providers.dialogDesc: Enter an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Testing sends a real completion request.
providers.name: Name

platforms.title: Messaging platforms
platforms.desc: Connect Amadeus to Telegram, QQ (OneBot v11), Discord, Slack, or any webhook service. Every platform shares the same sessions, memory, and affinity.
platforms.empty: No platforms connected yet. Once added, external messages reach the same Amadeus.
platforms.bindHint: Send /bind <code> in the platform to link an external account to a desktop user (codes are generated in Settings → Feishu). Unlinked accounts get an automatic profile per platform + account.
platforms.dialogDesc: Configuration stays in the local brain service; leaving a secret blank keeps the saved value.
platforms.name: Name
platforms.discordApiBase: API base URL (optional, official by default)
platforms.slackApiBase: API base URL (optional, official by default)

config.title: Configuration
config.modelDebugHint: Models other than Kurisu have no custom emotion faces or comic overlays; use them to debug model loading, lip sync, and motions.
config.previewHint: Click to preview. During voice chat the AI switches expressions and gestures automatically.

debug.title: Developer Debug
debug.placeholder: Enter Chinese text to run the full voice pipeline (bilingual → TTS)
debug.hint: Enabled once the voice pipeline is integrated

memory.title: Memory & Relationship
memory.subtitle: Amadeus remembers what matters from real conversations; affinity grows from real interactions. Nothing that did not happen shows up here.
memory.loginRequired: Sign in to see memory and relationship
memory.addPlaceholder: Add one manually — e.g. "likes coding late at night"
memory.empty: No memories yet. After you talk, important things are remembered automatically — or add one above.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.footnote: Affinity comes only from real turns and memories: +1 per turn, more for opening up, deep conversation, or finishing a task together.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: Import documents; chat retrieves the real passages and answers only from them.
knowledge.emptyHint: Create one, then import txt / md files, web pages, or pasted text.
knowledge.searchHint: Uses the same TF-IDF keyword retrieval as chat and returns real passages.
knowledge.uploadHint: Plain text files (txt / md / json / csv / log). Convert PDF / DOCX to text first.
knowledge.loginRequired: Sign in to use the knowledge base

automations.title: Automations
automations.subtitle: Let Amadeus run a real turn on schedule: digests, checks, reminders.
automations.name: Task name
automations.promptPlaceholder: What Amadeus should do when it fires, e.g. search three important AI news stories and summarize them.
automations.emptyHint: Create one with an instruction and a schedule. It really runs and keeps the result in its own session.

workbench.title: Agent workbench
workbench.providerEmpty: No model service connected — using built-in config

graph.title: Session run graph
graph.subtitle: Parallel sessions in this workspace
graph.emptyHint: Create a session and its run lane will appear here.
graph.historyHint: Inactive sessions are drawn from message counts; open one for full nodes

terminal.title: Tool activity
terminal.empty: No tool activity in this session yet

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.empty: HTML / SVG / Mermaid from assistant replies appears here
